LAW AND MOTION 301, RULING - A R G U E D; DEFENDANT LEVI STRAUSS & COMPANY'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT OR IN THE ALTERNATIVE SUMMARY ADJUDICATION - MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT IS DENIED. SUMMARY ADJUDICATION IS GRANTED AS TO UNOPPOSSED CAUSES OF ACTION AND AS TO DISCRIMINATION BECAUSE THAT CLAIM IS TIME BARRED. SUMMARY ADJUDICATION AS TO THE RETALIATION CLAIM AND WRONGFUL TERMINATION IN VIOLATION OF PUBLIC POLICY CAUSES OF ACTION IS DENIED. THE PLAINTIFF HAS CARRIED HER BURDEN OF PRESENTING SPECIFIC SUBSTANTIAL EVIDENCE SHOWING THAT DEFENDANT'S LEGITMATE BASIS FOR ITS ACTIONS WERE PRETEXTUAL. PARTIES TO MEET AND CONFER AS TO FORM OF ORDER PURSUANT TO CCP 437 C(G). JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: JOYCE LONG, CSR # 8620 (301/PJB)
